question: What was our earned premium by product in Q3 2026?

report.interpretation: Earned premium (USD) from exposure_monthly, summed over July, August and September 2026 (calendar Q3), grouped by product. All 8 states are included. The extract date is 2026-09-30, so the quarter is fully covered.
report.answer: Q3 2026 earned premium was about $21.47M in total. Home was $13.94M and auto was $7.53M.
report.answer_sql: select product, sum(earned_premium) as earned_premium from exposure_monthly where month>=DATE '2026-07-01' and month<DATE '2026-10-01' group by product order by product

findings.claim: Q3 2026 earned premium by product: auto $7,525,460.33 and home $13,944,627.48. Each product has 24 rows (3 months x 8 states).
findings.evidence_sql: select product, sum(earned_premium) ep, count(*) n from exposure_monthly where month>=DATE '2026-07-01' and month<DATE '2026-10-01' group by product
